_comment: LAN variant of firebase.json, used only by `npm run emulate:lan`.
Identical to firebase.json except that every emulator binds to 0.0.0.0
instead of 127.0.0.1, so a phone on the same Wi-Fi can reach them. That
is the whole point, and also the whole risk: while this is running, any
device on the network can read and write the emulator. Use it on a
network you trust, and stop it when you are done.
Nothing real is exposed. The project id is still demo-maestrotrack, which
Firebase treats as purely local, so the emulators refuse to contact
maestrotrack-3c2cf at all. The data here is whatever you typed into it
this session; it is held in memory and discarded on exit.
Everyday work should keep using `npm run emulate`, which stays on
127.0.0.1 and is reachable only from this machine.
